The bounded local landing-page narrative, product-first navigation, evidence layering, sentence cleanup, narrow-width containment, protecting tests, browser validation, and documentation closeout completed. Final scope reconciliation accepted all seven current-task paths and rejected only the preserved user-owned excluded .codex/config.toml path; no exception or ownership transfer was inferred. The recorded agentgov check governance command was unsupported by the current CLI; the supported task and repository checks supplied the corresponding evidence without rewriting the admitted plan. Native current-Agent advisory review srv-36e5dd02da20bee026f32390fa72766f found no correction-required drift and retained publication and reader-outcome validation as unknowns. The task is paused without Git, publication, release, deployment, report generation, protected-report rewriting, or follow-on authority.
